prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied isolated pixel-art prop image. Preserve the existing prop design, colors, silhouette, pixel clusters and separation between objects exactly. Change ONLY the background: completely REMOVE the white/gray checkerboard from the image and export the objects on an ACTUAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with an alpha channel (zero alpha outside the objects). A checkerboard is not transparency: do not draw, replace, or leave any checkerboard pixels. No white, gray, black, colored or patterned matte. No shadows or glow outside the prop silhouettes. The final deliverable must be a true transparent PNG cutout; keep both objects and their existing geometry.
outcome: Both tool outputs remained opaque RGB. They were rejected for runtime use. The selected magenta originals were generated after explicit authorization to perform runtime key/despill; originals stay intact.
